question: If Ishwar covers 721 km in a boat in 42 hours against the stream and he takes 15 hours with the stream, then find the speed of the stream.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed of stream = [Distance ÷ 2] × [ (1 ÷ Downstream time) − (1 ÷ Upstream time) ]

⇒ Stream speed = (721 ÷ 2) × [ (1 ÷ 15) − (1 ÷ 42) ]

⇒ Stream speed = 360.5 × [ (42 − 15) ÷ (15 × 42) ]

⇒ Stream speed = 360.5 × (27 ÷ 630) = 360.5 × (3 ÷ 70)

⇒ Stream speed = 1081.5 ÷ 70 = 15.45 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 15.45 km/hr.**
